English: As of September 2015, WHO recommends that people at substantial risk of HIV infection should be offered tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF)-based oral PrEP as an additional prevention choice, as part of comprehensive prevention. Oral PrEP is highly effective at preventing HIV when used as directed. In 2021, WHO recommended that the dapivirine ring may be offered as an additional prevention choice for women at substantial risk of HIV and, in 2022, that long-acting injectable cabotegravir (CAB-LA) may be offered as an additional prevention choice for people at substantial risk of HIV. Other products (e.g., multipurpose prevention products that combine antiretroviral drugs with contraception) are currently studied as additional PrEP options.
Kiswahili: Kufikia Septemba 2015, WHO inapendekeza kwamba watu walio katika hatari kubwa ya kuambukizwa VVU wanapaswa kupewa PrEP yenye msingi wa tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) kama chaguo la ziada la kuzuia, kama sehemu ya uzuiaji wa kina. Oral PrEP ina ufanisi mkubwa katika kuzuia VVU inapotumiwa kama ilivyoelekezwa. Mnamo 2021, WHO ilipendekeza kwamba pete ya dapivirine inaweza kutolewa kama chaguo la ziada la kuzuia kwa wanawake walio katika hatari kubwa ya VVU na, mnamo 2022, kwamba sindano ya muda mrefu ya cabotegravir (CAB-LA) inaweza kutolewa kama chaguo la ziada la kuzuia kwa watu walio katika hatari kubwa ya VVU. Bidhaa zingine (k.m., bidhaa za kuzuia matumizi nyingi zinazochanganya dawa za kurefusha maisha na uzazi wa mpango) kwa sasa zinachunguzwa kama chaguo za ziada za PrEP.
